title: PPL Panorama
description: A beautiful background captured in my server's lobby.
body:
# Resource Pack Description

A beautiful background captured in my server's lobby. It is designed to improve the visual experience with a cleaner and better-looking background, making the game feel a little more polished and enjoyable.

Although this pack was made for my own server's modpack, you are completely free to use it in your own game as well. If you want a nicer background and a small visual upgrade for your Minecraft experience, this resource pack may be a good fit.

# 资源包描述

这是于我服务器主城拍摄的精美背景。它可以让游戏界面拥有更干净、更好看的背景画面，使整体视觉体验更加精致、舒适。

虽然这个资源包最初是为我服务器整合包制作的，但你也完全可以把它用到自己的游戏里。如果你想让 Minecraft 拥有一个更漂亮的背景，并获得一点小小的视觉提升，那么这个资源包会很适合你。
